data.one_liner: Scroll to a specific child of any scrollable widget in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a mechanism to scroll to a specific index inside any Flutter scrollable widget using an AutoScrollController and AutoScrollTag. Supports both fixed and variable row heights.
use_when: You need to programmatically scroll a ListView or other scrollable widget to a specific item index.
You want to highlight children when they are scrolled into view.
avoid_when: You do not need to target specific child indices programmatically in your scroll views.
strengths: Works with any Flutter scrollable widget.
Supports both fixed and variable row heights.
Provides optional highlighting capabilities for targeted items.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping children in AutoScrollTag widgets and using a custom controller.
Variable row height scrolling relies on estimation and search mechanisms.
